# MET v3 source provenance

Local MediaTek MET v3 source copy used by the GQ5012BF1 Target C kernel.  The
authorized source drop did not carry Git metadata.  This repository is the
source-owning pin for the copy used in Campaign 14/15; the only LieppOS edit is
the Kbuild relative-path fix documented in the Campaign 14 source-changes file.
No register values, provider names or firmware blobs were synthesized.
